source.source_boundary: FailureMode.OPID supports OPHOURS and CALHOURS; CALHOURS expresses calendar exposure, including time without mission operations. Traditional Item/ItemFailureRate clock restrictions are not tested by this variant.

delta.mechanism: Change only FM-POS-A.OPID from OPHOURS to CALHOURS and description label; all other model tables, FRQ=300000, seed, missions, direct CM and horizon remain unchanged.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Four native CLI steps, exact source roundtrip and zero conversion errors pass under the guarded session-0 SSH runner.
At least one FM-POS-A failure occurs in an idle non-mission interval in the CALHOURS child; the accepted OPHOURS parent has no such failure in the same interval.
Native events trace each observed FMID failure, system CM action, completion or horizon truncation; report totals reconcile.
The exact parent delta is OPID and description only; no traditional FRT is introduced.
Raw source, invocation and closure hashes remain sealed and independent reviewer replays the comparison.
limits: Only one FMID and fixed 36-hour seed/model; traditional item OPHOURS behavior is supported by prior D01 evidence but not re-accepted here.
Calendar and operation clocks have unequal exposure; failure counts are one stochastic realization, not estimated comparative failure rates.
Other seeds, clock transitions during maintenance or a long all-idle stretch, traditional CALHOURS/MISSIONS negative tests, GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
